National Summary 
Highlights by Federal Reserve District 
Overall Economic Activity 
Economic growth downshifted slightly to a moderate pace in early July through August. The stronger sectors of the econo-
my of late included manufacturing, transportation, nonfinancial services, and residential real estate. The deceleration in 
economic activity was largely attributable to a pullback in dining out, travel, and tourism in most Districts, reflecting safety 
concerns due to the rise of the Delta
